title: 1226 | Front-end Developer
description: Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is looking for a Front-end Developer to join our team. Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required Our client is an international organization supporting global environmental and sustainability initiatives. The engagement focuses on developing and supporting enterprise applications, digital services, and technology solutions used across the organization. Specialists will collaborate with internal teams and external partners in an international environment, following established architecture, security, and delivery standards. We are looking for a Front-end Developer to build and maintain responsive, accessible web applications. You will work closely with UX/UI designers, Business Analysts, architects, and backend developers to translate business requirements and design specifications into reliable user interfaces. Responsibilities Develop and maintain web interfaces using React, TypeScript, and component-based architectures. Integrate frontend applications with APIs, backend services, and authentication flows. Ensure accessibility in line with WCAG 2.1 AA or equivalent standards. Improve usability, frontend performance, and client-side security. Develop unit tests, apply automated testing practices, and resolve defects. Participate in code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to Agile delivery. Requirements At least 5 years of experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining frontend applications, including React and TypeScript. At least 5 years of experience collaborating within multidisciplinary software delivery teams. At least 3 years of experience using Jira in collaborative delivery environments. Experience with API integrations, component-based development, and implementing interfaces from designs or prototypes. Experience with unit testing and automated testing practices. Experience using AI-assisted development tools, with critical validation of generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field. At least one relevant professional certification, such as Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I, PL-400, AZ-204, AWS Certified Developer – Associate, or equivalent. Would be a plus: For university degrees, the awarding institution must rank among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
